mechanical_checks.method: PowerShell JSON parsing, Unicode token counts, byte hashes and direct arithmetic over authored values; no stored evaluator or runtime was added.
mechanical_checks.duration_rule: Count/2.5 +0.5 seconds except the declared MR-020 five-word interrupted prefix; this validates an author's estimate, not speech timing.
mechanical_checks.interval_rule: Authored intervals treated as half-open [start,end); touching endpoints are not overlap. Real stop latency remains untested.

coverage_limits: The six-minute mission and 7:30 end are fictional clock values; no timed performance occurred. All nine companion utterance windows fit authored arithmetic, not measured pronunciation or speech speed.
The scheduled MR-020 stop at exactly 198 seconds is a plan. No microphone, PTT cancellation, playback interruption, acoustic overlap or device latency was exercised.

The scene is unmuted throughout. Global mute/PTT rules are consistent in the profile and audition; actual mute/unmute behavior is not demonstrated by this scene. The unchanged PRC-011 remains separate static coverage.
Native-radio occupancy is stipulated. No detector or unknown-occupancy fallback is implemented or demonstrated; the three silence decisions do not prove real channel availability.

Unchanged damage is suppressed five seconds later. No exact 20/30-second boundary, event race, radio queue, rearm, TTL or command-ledger behavior was executed. There are no spoken unsolicited P3/P4 beats to exercise their cooldown.
Dialogue, intended-full-line and cancellation notes are manually authored. No runtime model, repeated sampling, held-out case, semantic engine or robustness evaluation was run.
Native field access, actor identity, ownership, native acceptance/effects and manual-order sensing remain fictional prerequisites. No bridge, game/editor or new control action was exercised.
Attributed/conflicting reports and roleplay remain uncommitted in the text; this review did not execute the separate memory model, inspect saves or write persistent campaign memory.
Written style differences and source fidelity can be reviewed; user enjoyment, vocal gender/performance, intelligibility, accent, naming recognition and preference remain untested.
The reader preview's UI/selector/browser checks are a separate parent-owned artifact and are not included in this semantic grade.
